title: Agentic Workspace Evaluation Observe Result
description: Result returned by the evaluation.observe generated operation.

kind.description: Discriminator identifying an evaluation observe result.

outcome.description: Whether the operation appended a new observation or returned an idempotent duplicate.

evaluation_id.description: Registered evaluation id that received the observation.

criterion.description: Criterion id observed within the registered evaluation definition.

result.description: Observed result for the selected criterion.

result_identity.description: Stable identity for the admitted decision-bearing evaluation result.

supersedes.description: Result identities superseded by this admitted observation.

idempotency_key.description: Stable duplicate-detection key for retry-safe observation append.

store_revision.description: Revision fingerprint of the local observation store after the operation.

storage.description: Storage and retention details returned for a newly appended observation.
